_comment: Variant E2 — combines Variant F (regime-conditional TC kill) with WIDER STOPS. Counterfactual analysis (Agent 3, 2026-05-10) showed wider stops alone give PF +0.03 (essentially nothing). But combined with TC-bull-kill, fewer net losers + slightly less aggressive stops on remaining trades MAY add 0.1-0.2 to PF. Run via: python3 backtest.py --portfolio --days 250 --config-override config/variants/E2_regime_plus_wider_stops.json

setup_score_multiplier_by_regime._comment: Variant F regime-conditional kills (already in main config). Repeated here for explicit per-variant audit trail.

bull.reason_kill: PF 0.55, accounts for 79.5% of all backtest losses; late entries in extended bull get whipsawed.

technicals._comment: Variant E2 — widen the stop multiplier from 1.25× ATR (current) to 1.5× ATR. Also tighten trail-from-peak activation to 1.0% (was 2.0%) so winners hand off to trail sooner.

min_rr._comment: Wider stops require slightly higher target multiplier to maintain R:R 3.0. Targets become wider too.

_caveat: Counterfactual analysis (Agent 3) showed wider stops alone don't lift PF — losers are sustained adverse moves, not whipsaws. The hypothesis is that REMOVING the bull-regime TC bleed (Variant F) makes the remaining trades less correlated with the failure mode where wider stops would have helped. If E2 doesn't beat F-alone, this hypothesis is wrong and stops aren't the lever — entry quality is.
